{
  "id": "implement-production-preflight-and-eve-auth",
  "title": "Implement read-only Production preflight and explicit Eve auth",
  "status": "pending",
  "dependsOn": [
    "revalidate-clean-codex-preview-baseline"
  ],
  "description": "Add a schema-backed, read-only Production preflight and explicit deployed Eve authentication before any Production mutation.",
  "implementationNotes": [
    "Set the app-owned Eve policy to eveChannel({ auth: [vercelOidc(), localDev()] }) and test Vercel OIDC acceptance, deployed anonymous rejection, and localhost-only localDev behavior.",
    "Keep deployment preflight at the app/CLI boundary. Reuse AgentModelProviderConfig, CodexProxyConfig, CodexOAuthSubject, and package errors rather than defining Vercel/profile DTO mirrors.",
    "Fail closed on wrong Vercel project/scope, missing target variable name/binding, Preview/branch/ad hoc proxy host, mock/local mode, missing route protection, shared derived namespace identity, or missing accepted rollback references.",
    "Decode only the Vercel metadata fields needed for a sanitized go/no-go result; the command cannot deploy, alias, set variables, provision storage, or write profiles."
  ],
  "mandatoryVerification": [
    "Verify flat meaningful Effect.gen/Effect.fn flow; expected typed errors are handled in .pipe(...) with catchTag, catchTags, or mapError; contracts are canonical Effect Schema-derived; no unsafe casts, DTO mirrors, manual readers/mappers, raw JSON helpers, or trivial wrapper/helper sprawl.",
    "Tests prove positive personal-scope preflight and every wrong-target, shared-namespace, stale-host, missing-auth, wrong-mode, and read-only rejection.",
    "Direct HTTP tests prove Eve auth behavior and proxy health/private route policy; run focused checks and the global verification gate."
  ],
  "completionCriteria": [
    "A documented command returns only Schema-encoded sanitized go/no-go evidence.",
    "The explicit Eve auth policy and route matrix are accepted with three parent audit passes."
  ],
  "implementationImprovementAudit": {
    "requiredPasses": 3,
    "completedPasses": 0,
    "evidence": []
  },
  "commitAfterPassing": true
}

Ownership/write scope:
- apps/agent/agent/channels/eve.ts
- app-owned tests for explicit Eve auth
- app-owned Production preflight schemas/services/scripts/tests in apps/agent or apps/codex-proxy according to actual boundary ownership
- relevant package.json scripts/exports and minimal docs
- docs/product-specs/vercel-production-promotion.tasks.json and docs/exec-plans/active/vercel-production-promotion.md for sanitized worker evidence
Do not mutate Production or commit/push. Parent reviews, audits, accepts, and commits.

Implement a read-only preflight that can verify both linked projects' personal scope, stable production domains, target-scoped variable names/types, live mode requirement, explicit Eve auth presence, Deployment Protection, disjoint Preview/Production namespace/key-id identities without printing values, and rollback reference availability. It must have no mutation capabilities. Prefer input via a mode-0600 untracked Vercel metadata snapshot or command adapter at the CLI edge if live API auth is not an app concern. Decode only minimal canonical Schema contracts and emit Schema-encoded sanitized go/no-go evidence. Do not create a broad Vercel SDK wrapper or local DTO mirror.

Add explicit:
import { localDev, vercelOidc } from "eve/channels/auth";
import { eveChannel } from "eve/channels/eve";
export default eveChannel({ auth: [vercelOidc(), localDev()] });
Test the authored channel/build behavior and direct route matrix as practical without duplicating Eve internals.

Use Effect TS native approaches first. Prefer Data, Schema, Array, Chunk, HashSet, HashMap, Match, Context, Layer, Config, Service, Record, Result, Exit, Bun/Platform Command, and ManagedRuntime over plain TypeScript helpers when code is fallible, async, runtime-owned, collection-heavy, or crosses a package, RPC, SSR, command, config, or service boundary.

Reuse canonical schemas, types, service contracts, errors, and branded identifiers from the owning package. Do not define standalone DTO mirrors or duplicate fields such as id: string, slug: string, status, or post metadata outside their canonical schema/type owner.

Keep one-off Effect logic inline at the consumer. Do not add tiny wrappers, mappers, transformers, switch/case branches, instanceof checks, unsafe casts, or manual encode/decode adapters when an Effect Schema/RPC/Match/Result/Exit primitive or owning service contract should carry the behavior.

For UI work, use primitive -> composite -> layout -> route and leaf ownership rules; no UI is expected here.

Run targeted tests/check-types/build and bun run verification. Do not mark task complete or increment parent audit counters. Report changed files and evidence.

I’ll inspect the promotion plan, current app boundaries, and the installed Eve authentication sources before making scoped changes. I will keep this read-only with respect to Production and leave task state/audit counters untouched.

The existing agent has no `eve.ts` channel file, while the promotion spec already requires the exact policy. I’m narrowing the preflight contract around a metadata snapshot so it stays at the CLI boundary and does not introduce a Vercel SDK surface.

The installed Eve documentation confirms the authored policy gives the desired route behavior: protected session routes reject anonymous callers, `vercelOidc()` validates deployed callers, and `localDev()` only accepts loopback (apart from `vercel dev`). I’m adding the policy and a sanitized snapshot verifier; it will validate only metadata and identity fingerprints, never values.

I have the required contracts and variable owners. The implementation will live in `apps/agent` because it is the promotion’s Eve-auth and agent-config boundary; the snapshot contains only a minimal, sanitized projection of Vercel metadata and opaque identity fingerprints.
